question: What are the proposed internal time to mitigate targets by severity for incident response, regardless of customer deployment tier?
answer:
The proposed internal time-to-mitigate (TTM) targets are the same across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments:

| Severity | Target |
|---|---|
| Sev0 | 30 minutes |
| Sev1 | 2 hours |
| Sev2 | 1 business day |
| Sev3 | 5 business days, or the next planned release train |

TTM runs from incident declaration to restored SLOs or a documented, acceptable degradation mode. These are draft internal targets for breach alerting and leadership escalation, not finalized customer commitments. [dsid_c83811391709468fa9534e6495c205e3]

Proposed draft SLA targets (v1 candidate)
========================================
Notes:
- Times are proposed internal targets for breach alerting + leadership escalation.
- TTM measured to: restored SLO or reduced to acceptable degradation mode (documented).
- TTF measured to: fix deployed OR (Sev2/Sev3 only) fix scheduled with owner + date.

TTM (same across tiers)
-----------------------
Sev0: 30 minutes
Sev1: 2 hours
Sev2: 1 business day
Sev3: 5 business days (or next planned release train)
